text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: To think I'd end up participating.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...No, but in a sense, it should be 
drawing attention.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow's headlines will surely read: 
'As expected of Aston Machan, a brilliant 
victory to crown the autumn'—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, could we get a quick word 
before the race?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Vodka-san, Daiwa Scarlet-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! Would something like my 
aspirations be alright?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... For this race, the clash between 
the two rivals is drawing a great deal of 
attention.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
If possible, having something like a 
declaration of war against each other 
would make it even more exciting, I 
think...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I see... Understood!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'll show you a version of me 
that's so much stronger than at the Oka 
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Brace yourself, Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh, that's my line! I'm on a total roll 
this year!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't matter how fast you try to run 
away, I'm snatchin' the lead right out 
from under ya!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I wish the both of you the best 
of luck!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...And off they go. Machan is here too, 
you know~.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...I understand. Those two are very 
popular.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
They were saying it in the stands too: "I 
wonder which one's gonna win."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, Ma-chan declared she's 
changing routes. It's only natural she'd 
fade from their sight.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
... Be that as it may... Be that as it 
may, we cannot let things remain as they 
are.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "I will remind them. Today, without fail."
